title: I can say this place is very affordable and friendly
name: Adam Guy
quote: As a deployed daddy of my daughter, Norah, Growing Kids has been wonderful! My wife is staying with her family and we decide to get Norah involved with other kids. We picked Growing Kids. I am in the middle of nowhere and really enjoyed getting pics of my baby while on deployment. Norah really came to love her school/day care and I want to thank all of you guys, teachers, assistants, and Emily for making Norah feel so special. There are many places we could’ve chosen, but this was the best choice! Growing Kids is a very nice place to bring children. I don’t look to saving money when it comes to my daughter. I can say this place is very affordable and friendly. I would definitely recommend them and take solace in knowing you get pics of your child right to your phone!

title: Jack said he wanted to dress up as his teacher
name: Amanda & Steve Zelechoski
quote: For Halloween this year, our 2 year old, Jack, said he wanted to dress up as his teacher Miss Donna. She’s not just Jack’s beloved daycare teacher; she also cared for our two older boys when they were each his age. Like many other teachers at daycare, she has been an incredible blessing for our entire family. Many of you know the trials and tribulations that come with raising small children. In our case, with two working parents who travel throughout the year, there are many times when my wife and I look at each other and ask, “How are we going to make it through the day?” That’s when the Miss Donna’s of the world step in. This incredible woman has potty-trained each of our 3 boys. No exaggeration – if it weren’t for her, all three would still be in diapers. As extra motivation for our second son, she even made him special underwear with cows and horses, because that’s what it took to motivate him. What a saint! We all have Miss Donna’s in our lives, both personally and professionally. What a great world we live in- that we can reach out for help when needed. Thank you to all the Miss Donna’s out there!

title: Growing kids has been nothing short of amazing
name: The Buch Family
quote: Growing Kids has been nothing short of amazing. It has been the perfect fit for us. Lucas loves going and is not only safe, but also learning and thriving! It’s one of the very few parenting decisions that I’ve never had to second guess. I know from the moment he arrives in the morning until he’s picked up at the end of the day, Lucas will be treated with love and respect from his teachers and any other staff that he comes into contact with. He is learning the basics like colors, numbers, letters, etc., but more than that, GK is helping us to guide him into being a good human. I don’t know what more I could ask from a day care. Thanks you so much for taking such good care of Lucas!

title: Growing kids is accommodating with every childs needs
name: Nicole Martinez
quote: We are incredibly happy with Growing Kids. The Director is personable, friendly and always upbeat. The staff are wonderful and absolutely loving and caring of the children. I have appreciated that Growing Kids is accommodating with every child’s needs. From supporting our infant son’s physical therapy developmental needs to allowing me to come in and nurse my little one during my lunch hour. Growing Kids has far exceeded our expectations of childcare. As a mother of two, I highly recommend this place.

title: I absolutely love this daycare as do my children
name: Kelsey R Malone
quote: I absolutely love this daycare as do my children. We have been with Growing Kids for almost 8 years! My children have always called daycare “school” and that’s just what it is. The children have time to play of course, but everything they do is centered on learning. They are amazing with their Pre-K classes. They help our children get on the right track and prepared for school. I’m so thankful for the wonderful staff that have taken care of my children and the amazing director. The director is so pleasant and easy to speak to. I couldn’t picture my children being in another daycare. We know everyone there and our family is very know as well. I highly recommend them!

title: I appreciate how the teachers let me know whats going on with my child
name: Shawntel Hawkins
quote: I appreciate how the teachers let me know what’s going on with my child while I am away. They make sure to keep me in the loop on what’s going on with him. As a parent of an only child I know he can be testy and challenging, but his teachers put forth the effort and continually show that he is cared for no matter how challenging he can be. Thank you!

title: I appreciate the variety of things that she is being taught
name: Clarissa Butler
quote: My child is doing extremely well in the Preschool 5 class. I appreciate the variety of things that she is being taught that isn’t common in a lot of the other classrooms. She’s also being exposed to STEM education! Thanks Ms. Laura for all you do!!

title: They have treated our children very well
name: Kelly Alberli
quote: We have used Growing Kids for our children for the past 8 years. They have treated our children very well during this time. Our children have developed a bond with almost all of their teachers. I feel like the staff know my children and have a genuine interest in their well-being and their education. If there have ever been concerns or questions, I have always been able to discuss them with the center. I feel it is a safe place for them when they are not in my care. Our daughter is doing excellent in grade school now and it is in large part due to the wonderful teachers she had at Growing Kids. My son is still at Growing Kids and his teachers are awesome.

title: Its the best daycare hands down
name: MaKayla Beebe
quote: I would recommend this to anyone!! It’s the best daycare hands down! Everyone was so respectful and helpful from the front desk to the teachers to the director. My son was in 2 different rooms there and I never had any issues! They do such awesome things with the kids especially in the summer!!

title: We have had nothing short of a phenomenal experience
name: Heather Hooley
quote:
Both of our children attend Growing Kid on SR 23. We have had nothing short of a phenomenal experience with everyone we have been in contact with.
Our oldest is in the Young Preschool class, and has completely flourished. He has learned how to express his emotions without yelling and throwing things, his language has increased tenfold, and he is genuinely happy to be in the classroom every day.
Our youngest started attending Growing Kids just shy of his first birthday. The teachers made the transition of sending him to school SO EASY. They treat him as their own. They always update us on what is going on with our child and in the classroom.
I have never felt more comfortable with a group of people around our children. Each and every staff member at the SR 23 location knows our boys (and us) by name.
If you are looking for a quality place to send your child where you won’t be worried about their care, Growing Kids is it.

title: My girls love growing kids
name: Karen Crabtree
quote: My girls love Growing Kids! We have been with them for a little over a year now and you can definitely tell that my kiddos are learning a lot and having fun while doing so! My oldest has even made up a song that she sings about her school too. When I drop them off for the day I know that they are in great hands. The staff is so kind and friendly, I’m so happy that we made the decision to bring our girls here.

title: The best decision i made
name: Sarah Paro
quote: The past 30 days at the Warsaw center have been fantastic. Honestly, for my children’s ongoing development coming to Growing Kids I feel was the best decision I made. My three year old in the last month’s vocabulary has exploded and I know much of that is thanks to your teachers. As a parent you are always worried if you are doing the right thing, but seeing the constant pictures I get from the teachers and updates on the curriculum, I have no doubt in my mind that Growing Kids is where they should be.

title: We have had such a great first month
name: Kayla Rogers
quote: We have had such a great first month with Growing Kids Warsaw center! Our infant room teachers have been so wonderful and take such great care of our daughter while we are at work. She is so happy to see them in the morning when I drop her off, which just proves that she is loved and cared for while there. We love all of the crafts she gets to do and feel like she is learning so many new skills already! She will turn one in a couple of months, and while we know she’ll be in great hands as she transitions into the next classroom, we will honestly be so sad to leave our wonderful teachers in the infant room. The front desk staff are always so welcoming, helpful and communicating with us. It really puts our minds at ease!

title: He learns so much and has a lot of fun
name: Michelle Drummond
quote: I made the right choice sending my son here! I have no worries when my child is in Growing Kids care! He learns so much and has a lot of fun. The teachers are fantastic!

title: Im so happy with his growth
name: Stephanie Wilhelm
quote: Connor is learning so much. I’m so happy with his growth, and the feedback I receive from the teachers. When he is struggling with behavior I love how we work together so discipline is consistent.

title: The staff does an incredible job
name: Erin Woods
quote: We’re only a month in, but feel like our Growing Kids teachers have already become an extended part of our family. The staff does an incredible job of answering questions, providing advice when solicited, and treating our child with love and affection. They’ve managed to make the transition back to work a smooth one for this first-time mom. Thanks for all that you do to make sure our little one is well taken care of during the day!

title: I love how caring my kids teacher are with them
name: Jessica Arellano
quote: I have two of my children going to Growing kids in Goshen. I love how caring my kids teacher are with them. I love that I can go and talk to the director if I have any concern over my kids and she helps anyway she can to make sure my kids are safe and have a great time while they are under their care! As a parent I want my kids to be safe and have fun while I am away from them. Growing Kids makes me feel comfortable dropping them off every day from the front office staff to the teachers that takes care of my kids.

title: My son loved being in the toddler class
name: Brittney Plank
quote: Teachers are very personable and develop great relationships with the kids. My son LOVED being in the toddler class he was excited for school and always got excited when I asked him if he wanted to go see his teachers. He is now in YPSC and loves his new teachers too! Its also nice that both sets of teachers are eager to tell the parents what their child did that day at school and encourage the kids to tell their parents as well and even though the kids move up to different classes with different teachers it’s great to hear their old teachers still enjoy seeing them even if just for a quick hello. Growing Kids has a great curriculum and structured environment for the kids helping them learn more and develop more than your average house held babysitters. A+++

title: They always make you feel like a vip
name: Magda Aker
quote: I have been coming to Growing Kids since they open and I have been happy with how all of my concerns are addressed and also how they always make you feel like a VIP from the greeting to anything else.

title: Everyone is so nice and always helpful
name: LaJeana Peli
quote: Growing Kids has been very helpful and understanding during a very difficult time in my family’s life. I lost my husband unexpectedly and Growing Kids has been very understanding of that, and with my child to help her through the pain and confusion! Everyone is so nice and always helpful with anything I ask of them. My daughter has really grown and flourished at your facility. She loves coming every day and is excited to tell me about her day when I pick her up!

title: My children have benefited so much from attending growing kids
name: Kim Noetzel
quote:
I absolutely love Growing Kids!  I cannot even begin to express how much I like and appreciate Growing Kids and their staff.  I like the facility, the extra programs they have for the families especially around the holidays, the curriculum they use, the atmosphere, the personality of the staff, and the extra activities they bring in for the children.
I was very particular in my search for a preschool.  My oldest son was at a fantastic preschool before we moved to this area.  His previous teachers knew my son, treated him as their own, taught him a curriculum and allowed me to be at ease while being a working mom.  I would love to be able to stay at home with my children but since I can’t I wanted a preschool that would treat my sons the way I would, teach them a curriculum, and allow them to learn through social activities and play.  I visited several preschools and there were none that could meet all my requirements except for Growing Kids.
Growing Kids makes my life easier because I know my children are taken care of, educated and have fun every day.  I love the Life Cubby App which allows me to check on my children throughout the day and know how they are doing.  I love seeing pictures of my children throughout the day as well.  I have called to check on them and the staff is always very accommodating and will update me on my children’s days.  I have developed relationships with my children’s teachers and they do a great job of communicating with me on my children and their daily progress.
I wanted a preschool where my children would be known, cared for and educated.  I toured several preschools and would like a few things but wasn’t comfortable about leaving my children there for an entire day.  I walked into Growing Kids and fell in love with the assistant director, Megan and the director, Sarah.  They remembered my children by name and were so friendly and personable.  After I toured the facility I knew immediately that I would feel completely comfortable with my children spending their days at Growing Kids if they couldn’t be home with me.
I absolutely LOVE the teachers and feel like my sons have really been fortunate in the teachers they have had in their classrooms.  I have developed relationships with the teachers in the classrooms and have open communication with the teachers to be able to keep up with how my students are doing daily.  My youngest son started in the infant room and Ms. Hannah was absolutely amazing with my son.  I knew my son was in the best care besides being with me or a family member.  I trusted Ms. Hannah with a reference on what teachers and room Connor should move to after the infant room.  Connor did well in Toddler 1 and is now in Young Preschool A and has great teachers once again that treat him as his own.  My oldest son started in Preschool 3 with Ms. Kim and Ms. Keyanna who were amazing teachers.  My son absolutely LOVED both of them and grew so much in the year he spent with them.  He is now in Preschool 6 and we chose Ms. Toni and Ms. A.J. because of the curriculum, structure and how well they prepare students for Kindergarten.  I love the administrative staff and cannot say enough great things about all the individuals I have had direct contact with.
Moving to this area was a huge adjustment for my children especially my oldest.  Growing Kids has truly helped my children.  Growing Kids and the staff provided my children with stability and an education during the day while my husband and I worked.  Ms. Keyanna and Ms. Kim were constant in Jaxon’s growth and development during our first year here.  He really likes them and still talks about them all the time.  He likes school and wants to go to school each day which makes it easier for me.   He has grown so much; socially, educationally and behaviorally.
I would recommend Growing Kids because of all the amazing staff, the curriculum they offer and all the programs they offer.  My children have benefited so much from attending Growing Kids so I would highly recommend it to anyone.

title: The one word to describe growing kids is family
name: The Garber Family
quote:
The one word to describe Growing Kids is Family.  We consider them our family. We started attending Growing Kids when our oldest daughter was 1 years old.  I was a first time mom heading back to teaching and was torn over putting my daughter in daycare or staying home.  The decision to put her into Growing Kids completely changed our lives for the best!  Sydney has grown in so many ways.  She is independent, kind, smart, disciplined, and enjoys spending time away from home!  I contribute each of those characteristics to her teachers at Growing Kids.
When we found out we were expecting our second little girl, having her attend Growing Kids was a definite!  Katheryn was only 4 months old when she started Growing Kids.  The love, attention, hugs, and schedule she experiences each and everyday is amazing.
We tell everyone parent we know how much we love Growing Kids.  They are a blessing to our family.

title: His teachers love him almost as much as you do
name: Brooke
quote:
I just got a bunch of pictures of Sam playing outside and it reminded me that I wanted to take a quick moment to tell you how much we appreciate you and the team at Growing Kids. We had a stressful summer with Mason getting hurt at the camp at the Y. I had a moment where I wanted to quit my job and keep him right by my side for every moment. I honestly didn’t know what we were going to do for the rest of the summer. When my mom said, “Why don’t you send him to Growing Kids?” I immediately felt a huge weight off my shoulders. All of the teachers in the Toddler 2 room have been so amazing with Sam, there was no question that Mason wouldn’t be safe and cared for as well. He is having a great time at camp and we appreciate the combination of learning and fun. The move to your camp made our mornings infinitely easier. We spend our morning relaxing and enjoying the time together instead of scrambling to make lunches and find lost items that are needed for the day. Your team’s organization and planning is obvious and greatly appreciated.
More than anything, I want to let you know how much we love Sam’s teachers. There is nothing better than dropping your kid off knowing that his teachers love him almost as much as you do. Aaron and I have joked that if Sam ever goes missing, we are checking Miss Cas’s house first. She is absolutely wonderful with him and with us. I can’t tell you how much I love getting pictures of him playing and enjoying his day. The time that the toddler teachers spend orchestrating activities and crafts is appreciated.
Trusting someone else to care for your kids is extremely difficult. Thank you so much for making it a little easier.

title: I have two daughters who attend the chesterton
name: Laura (and Luke) Brennan
quote:
My name is Laura Brennan, and I have two daughters who attend the Chesterton facility full time. Please feel free to copy Sarah so she can pass on anything she feels appropriate to anyone else.
Last summer, we moved our girls to Growing Kids from another daycare in Chesterton after very serious considerations– I did not want to upset the girls by moving them, as we were pleased where we were.  My husband and I agree that it was absolutely the right decision, and we have not regretted it for a minute.  The girls transitioned fairly quickly, and now even though we would all rather be at home with each other–they love going to their ‘big’ school. Although my heart breaks every morning dropping them off, knowing how loved and cared for they are there makes that much easier to handle.
Everyone at the Chesterton school has been phenomenal- Sarah Scott and the other office staff (we’re just getting to know Teddy, but she’s been great too!), the kitchen staff, and all of the teachers have been so welcoming and respectful– I don’t even know where to start, and apologize for what is probably going to be a long read!
First of all, all of the little things that the school does are so very appreciated, and really show that Growing Kids cares and wants to make families feel welcome–and isn’t afraid to put a little time, effort and money into it.  To mention a few–soccer camp, bringing in the ‘Kola ice?’ truck, bringing in art teachers, having Mother’s Day, Father’s Day and so many other parties–where the kids and parents never go home empty handed.  The creativity and thoughtfulness that the teachers and staff put into these parties is exceptional. Last winter the children put on an amazing Holiday show at Chesterton High School-I hope that will happen again this year, I’ve been looking forward to it since the last one! One day, the center had a huge ‘Welcome Home’ banner–and there were American flags and crafts all over the place–I cried when Sarah told me that one of the parents was coming home from the service and surprised their child that day.
Sarah has been so easy to communicate with, and shows true concern and care for her families.  The few times I had minor issues, or need to change a schedule due to my lack of work, she handled everything professionally, quickly, and very sincerely. I feel very welcome to talk with her if I ever have a concern.
Our 4 year old daughters last teacher–Ms. Maria– is by far our most beloved teacher –and we have had plenty of amazing ones
in 4 years
of daycare!  Katie just transitioned out of her room, and it makes her day to run into her in the hallway.  Maria’s classroom is full of energetic 3-4 year olds, quite often with a few friends who take a little extra care and attention.  She handles every child with such care, compassion, love, and light-heartedness–and ensures that all the children in her class are sharing that same respect and kindness with each other.  Such an important lesson to be learned at such an early age.  Her patience and kindness towards everyone reflects so positively in her children, and in the way my four year old treats her little sister at home.  Ms. Maria has also taught her children Spanish–these four year olds can count to 50 in Spanish, learn new words daily, and love it!  I hope that Growing Kids continues to hire staff who can provide a second language–it is such a great opportunity for the kids! Ms. Maria’s room was always so creatively decorated with the kids arts and crafts on display- she excelled in making the room feel like their home.  (Is it too early to request that Kira is put into Ms. Maria’s room when she is old enough?!)
Katie’s other teacher- Ms. Shelly has been exceptionally kind as well, and we are happy to get to know her better as she’s moved up with Katie to Ms. Jenn’s room–who also in the short time we’ve known her seems to be great!
We’ve been out of school for a three day weekend just now, and our two year old was excited to go back to school today.  Her teachers- Ms. Krystal and Ms. Irisha (and for a while Ms. Sarah) have all been amazing, and have treated Kira with such love and respect as a tiny little human. They have taught her so much- letters, numbers, yoga, crafts, activities–and she loves it! She has been a challenging child, and outside of myself and a grandparent or two, she hasn’t come to trust many other adults (not even my husband/her dad unfortunately–he would tell you that himself!)–but she is so welcomed in her room by these amazing teachers that she easily and gladly runs to their arms every morning. While we have never had Ms. Kim who is in her room every morning as a regular teacher, she has been a huge positive influence on both girls, and we appreciate her care so much. It takes a special sort of person to still be wearing a smile (and clean clothes) after being in a room full of potty-training two year olds, and they always are. Kira’s previous teachers, Ms. Lindsay and Ms. Sam were amazing as well- very welcoming, caring, and so patient with these little people!
One of the things that stood out when we were considering moving to Growing Kids was that the existing teachers felt appreciated by the managers. I don’t know what is being done to make this happen, but from my perspective this appears to be the case- I have never heard any complaints about ‘management’, which is wildly different from where we were before. Being treated well by your company makes a huge difference, and I’m glad to support one who seems to be doing just that.
We have been very happy with the facility itself- it is always clean and maintained, and decorated very cheerfully and welcoming. The girls like the food so much I have a hard time getting them to eat the food at home! I like the variety of foods, and that there is always something outside of the standard ‘kid food’s’ offered. I can only imaging the challenges of feeding so many people so many times of the day…but I often wonder if there is a way of becoming less dependent on Styrofoam and plastic. If there would be potential to consider bringing in plates/cups/utensils-even enough for the day, and bringing them home to clean, I would be happy to try something out (but don’t want to add to an already complicated system).
I’ve enjoyed checking in on the kids days via Life Cubby, and appreciate all the notes the teachers put into them–I know it takes extra time that they have very little of.   I am pleased that there are different spaces the children can move to throughout the day– the playground, Main Street, the garden, Minds in Motion, and even just having hallways wide enough to get the small kids out of their room on a walk for a few minutes.  I was a little disappointing to hear that Minds in Motion was changed to a classroom- hopefully that time and those activities can continue in a different space. As someone who likes to move around a lot, and has a hard time sitting in one space for too long, I greatly value allowing the kids the opportunity to get outside of their main 4 walls throughout the day.
I am glad the kids get outside once or twice a day- especially when it takes so much extra effort to dress everyone up in snow gear! It makes a huge difference on their day, even if the elements only allow them to be out for a few minutes. They have been loving water day as well. They have had a lot of fun getting to know their outdoor space- the playground, the wetland, the grass, trees, observing the world outside the center, and all the great music activities and little bikes they can ride; we love the variety and the space they get to enjoy!
So, even though this is a little late for a Happy first birthday to the Chesterton school, we would like to thank all of the hard working staff there for a wildly successful first year (from our perspective at least)! We appreciate all that you do, and trust you with the most important people in our entire world.

title: I just wanted to say thank you
name: Jennifer Wiest
quote:
I just wanted to say thank you to all the teachers and everyone who has helped Callen come out of his shell.  Today was his first full day at Kindergarten and there were no tears, I have to say that he has come a long way since his first month at Growing Kids. I do believe that his personality is all due to the nurturing that the staff there gave him.  I really want to thank Ms. Lu, Ms. Cindy, Ms. Charmaine, Ms. Tina (sp), Ms. Ashley, and Ms. Lauren I believe these teachers have helped him overcome his shyness and have given him the confidence he needs to succeed in school.
So thank you again for everything

title: Friendly environment and the excellent teachers
name: Sarah Larson
quote: I chose Growing Kids because of the friendly environment and the excellent teachers.  I can tell my child is loved and is learning a lot!

title: Friendly staff and excellent reputation
name: Tami Para
quote: Growing Kids is a very clean and organized center. Friendly staff and excellent reputation. I really like how almost all of the staff seems to know almost every child!

title: The management staff is outstanding compassionate
name: Yuki Gilbert
quote: I chose Growing Kids because of the professional demeanor, friendly, happy smiles from the staff, and the safety.  This is a great childcare center.  The management staff is outstanding, compassionate and always willing to do what is in the best interest of the children.

title: I know that my children are being taken care of
name: Renae Wasson
quote: When I finally decided to send my children to daycare, Growing Kids had the most reputable reputation. I don’t have any worries about my children while they are there. I know that my children are being taken care of and that all the teachers there actually know my children and their personalities. They go out of their way to make sure they are happy and fell safe.

title: They genuinely care for my children
name: Linda Johnson
quote: I like that all the teachers are certified, there are cameras in the rooms, and I like the educational environment. My children have been attending Growing Kids for a total of 6 years. I love the teachers and feel they genuinely care for my children.

title: Ive loved the curriculum for her from day 1
name: Alisha Howton
quote: My daughter has been with Growing Kids since she was 1 years old. I’ve LOVED the curriculum for her from day 1!

title: My son is actually learning
name: Brianna Oliver
quote: I love the security and how my son and the teachers interact. I love what’s offered because my son is actually learning!

title: My daughter always comes home happy
name: Theresa Hutkins
quote: I’ve always heard great things about Growing Kids. I was referred by another family that goes to Growing Kids. They’ve always been very happy. I am very satisfied with Growing Kids and the teachers. My daughter always comes home happy!

title: My son seems very happy here
name: Melissa Carper
quote: I like Growing Kids because of the great scheduling. Open earlier, closes later, open during the holidays and the location is convenient. The menu is great! I also appreciate how accommodating Growing Kids has been with my cloth diapers. My son seems very happy here.

title: Thank you and your amazing team
name: Eileen
quote: When we started at Growing Kids when my son was 2, I had no idea I would have two more children and spend 8 years with all those wonderful teachers. Today is our last day at GK. I know it may seem silly to be all emotional about daycare, but I’m so thankful for the care, kindness and education your team had shared with me and my children over the years. It’s a bittersweet day for me, but I wanted to share with you how happy I am to have trusted such a wonderful place with my children. Thank you and your amazing team!!!

title: The center looks amazing
name: Natasha Walser
quote: The center looks amazing!  I’ve heard great things about Growing Kids.  The perks are also so inviting.  I am really pleased at how patient and understanding my kids teachers are to their specific age group.

title: They offer wonderful opportunities for my child
name: Lyndsay Bowman
quote: Growing Kids has great teachers and staff. They offer wonderful opportunities for my child. Kindergarten is wonderful. Carson has come a long way in just a few weeks with Ms. Kim and Ms. Heather.

title: We recently enrolled our second child
name: Tim and Carrie Buss
quote: We recently enrolled our second child at Growing Kids.  The staff and the center are excellent!  Having used other centers and home daycares, I can honestly say that Growing Kids is the best!  There are weekly themes, daily learning activities and daily messages to home about their day.  From the earliest age, care is designed around the developmental stages of your child.  Honestly, we were struggling with potty – training at home, but within a week of training at Growing Kids, accidents are rare!  We trust the staff at Growing Kids to provide the best care possible for our child when we cannot be there.

title: How awesome your staff is amazing
name: Anna Smith
quote: My son completed preschool at Growing Kids and he is so far above his class that he is bored!  How awesome! Your staff is amazing!  I love Growing Kids, and would recommend to everyone!

title: Caring seemingly tireless and committed staff
name: Sarah James
quote: I don’t know what I would do if it weren’t for the outstanding, trustworthy, hardworking staff and administrators of Growing Kids.  I toured several child care centers, and interviewed numerous providers before coming to Growing Kids, where my search for the safest and best came to an end.  Growing Kids is the only one with a curriculum built around values to help my child grown intellectually, emotionally, socially and psychologically.  The caring, seemingly tireless and committed staff have made this a home away from home for my child, and set my mind at ease through every stage of her development.  My nearly two year old is excited to come to school every day, and I wouldn’t have her anywhere else.  Thank you to all of the very special people making this place all that it is!

title: Kudos to each and every one of your staff
name: Vlaemnick
quote: Growing Kids has been one of the most positive influences on both of our children!  Kudos to each and every one of your staff.  Keep up the excellent work!

title: No other daycare measures up
name: Danielle Fenner
quote: No other daycare measures up.  My kids aren’t being watched, they’re being taught.  Door key pad and fingerprint entry slips make me feel safe when I’m away.

title: Very safe and reliable teachers
name: Kayla Crawson
quote:
Very professional.  Very safe and reliable teachers that are very caring and loving.  Growing Kids follows all the rules and standards to be nationally accredited, very impressive!  Wonderful teachers and directors!
Growing Kids puts parents satisfaction over everything else!  Absolutely wonderful!

title: Thankful for growing kids
name: Adrienne Moore
quote:
1.  Thank you for having a staff lounge.  I know that this seems like its a ‘given’, but the child care I worked for did not have a staff lounge.  Reasons being: “it’s not a good use of money to add to the building” and “it creates a space for staff members to gossip”.  At Growing Kids, I remember using the staff lounge for many things: baby showers, pot lucks, making a personal call to home when I needed to, just relaxing and eating lunch on a snowy day.  I bonded with my fellow co-workers during the times in the staff lounge and it created a ‘team’ throughout the whole building.  It was a home away from home and I thank Growing Kids for offering a comforting space for the employees to go on their lunch breaks.
2.  Thank you for always acknowledging when it was our work anniversary.  When it came time for my one year anniversary at Growing Kids, I knew that I would have a meeting to discuss my yearly review and acknowledged for my hard work.  Every year after that, a meeting was scheduled promptly on or very near my anniversary and I could count on a meeting to discuss my work performance.  I knew that I wouldn’t automatically receive a raise, but I at least appreciated some feedback.
3.  Thank you for having a ‘Main Street’.  At my previous place of employment, this was again considered as ‘not a good use of money to add to the building.’  As a teacher, I REALLY appreciated having an indoor area to take my class to play, explore, do group activities and learn.  This was especially helpful on days when it was too cold outside, rainy or too hot.  The children and the teachers BOTH benefited from Main Street by getting out of the classroom at some time during the day.
4.  Thank you for showing appreciation to volunteers.  In my years at growing Kids, I volunteered at all or most of the community events such as the Easter egg hunt, holiday show, etc.. In addition, my (now husband) volunteered with me to be the Easter bunny or Santa.  We both enjoyed doing this together, because not only was it fun to interact with the children, but we were also
shown appreciation in many ways
.  We would receive a simple thank you card, the teachers got to do an adult egg hunt when the Easter egg hunt was over, etc..  Simple things like this, showed me that Growing Kids really appreciated me spending my extra time to be a part of the many fun events outside of regular hours.
5. Thank you for providing dinner or snacks at all of the staff meetings. Growing Kids understood that many of us were taking time away from our families to be at the staff meetings at night.  Because of this, there was always some sort of meal or snack provided.  It was simple, but it again showed me how much I was appreciated and thought of as an employee with Growing Kids.
6.  Thank you for always giving
positive feedback
.  Whenever someone entered my classroom, I was given some sort of positive feedback.  I still remember Julie walking into my room and saying how much she loved our bulletin board and how it brightened the room.  There was also constructive criticism given , but there was just as much (if not more) positive feedback about my teaching skills.
I was TRUSTED and BELIEVED IN.
So, as we approach Thanksgiving and we think about what we are thankful for, one of my top things I am thankful for is Growing Kids and the time that I got to be an employee there.
Thank you & much Love,
Mrs. Adrienne Moore
Kindergarten Teacher

title: This is the nicest childcare ive seen in elkhart
name: The Bryner/Hindawi family
quote:
Dear Growing Kids family,
It is a very rare occasion that I write a letter of accolade such as this, however, given my family’s experience with Growing Kids on US-23, it is the prudent thing to do. It is not difficult to find a daycare or pre-school which is in the business of providing care for your child. It is an exception to find a structured organization whose business is but a catalyst for providing a home away from home, a parenting partnership, and a venue that even our spirited and expressive child was eager to attend, knowing that he was accepted and nurtured as a unique individual. In fact, the Growing Kids difference over another daycare was encouragingly notable within mere days from when our son first started attending. Your expertise at child development is not the entirety of the Growing Kids experience, albeit a substantial one. I have heard it said that it is during difficult times that real friends can shine. In the case of Growing Kids, who put people before profit and gave reassurance in times of need, I am simply unable to articulate our level of gratitude. It is your compassion which rivals your professionalism which has, more than anything, inspired this letter. It is why the Growing Kids staff are more like family as opposed to simply a vendor. It is why having to move on to regular school after being in partnership with you over the past couple years is as much somber as it is a moment of celebration. Thank you for all you have done. We will miss each of you, but we are most assuredly fortunate to have found you. You are, quite simply, the best.
Gratefully,
-The Bryner/Hindawi family
This is the nicest childcare I’ve seen in Elkhart. Good Job! Keep up the good work!

title: The teachers are committed and really are amazing caretakers
name: Will Randerson
quote: My wife had to move to South Bend for a 8 month period with our son (1 years old) while I had to stay in North Carolina with the military.  Under these circumstances we were unable to visit the Day Care or be able to really search around.  This would also be our sons first day care experience instead of spending all day with mom.  Let me just say that they were extremely helpful on the phone/email and were very understanding of our situation from the start.  The building is very secure and you are always greeted by someone at the front desk.  They have a great system of ensuring only you (or someone you have verified) may pick up your child.  They also have a great phone App to ask the parents questions or to share information to you about your child which is updated multiple times a day (i.e hes feeling sick, what he had ate that day, any sort of diaper changes etc).  My wife was uneasy at first but after a short period of time she has grown to love this daycare.  Within a week ALL the staff new my sons name and my wife.  There are multiple teachers for each group of kids and my wife or I never felt like our son was neglected or not taken care of.  They have a great scheduled with nap times, play time, fine motor skill time etc so you’re child is actually developing instead of just in a room with lots of toys.  The teachers are committed and really are amazing caretakers.  Our son started in the infant room and had moved to the toddler room which was a huge change for him but Growing kids eased him into it over a weeks time so he could get to know the other kids and teachers.  Growing Kids has been nothing but the best for our son and my wife and I are very upset that we will have to be leaving here.  We wish we could take this day care with us back to NC.  I never leave reviews on places but this one is so deserving of 5 stars.

title: The facility is so clean and well structured
name: Dainette Ward
quote: Growing kids provided an exceptional clinical experience. The facility is so clean and well structured around the children. Full of friendly, knowledgeable and helpful staff.

title: Teachers always make you feel very comfortable
name: Stevin “Ace” Yoder
quote:
We had always had issues on issues with the daycare we were taking our kiddo too and finally had enough and I had always heard great and wonderful things about Growing kids learning center! and it felt right in my gut to give it a try! I always had weird feelings dropping off the little one at the other daycare! Growing kids I have yet had any type of weird or negative feeling! Soon as you walk in the door they greet you with good morning! And when you walk out from the class room the teachers always make you feel very comfortable and tell you have a good day! They stay up to date on the Procare app all day long! Which is great knowing what your kiddo is eating at snack time lunch time and even pm snack time!! When they start naps and wake up to potty breaks! They are very understanding and nonjudgmental towards everyone who walks in the door! My kiddo is always beyond happy when we leave and always ready to go back! I would highly recommended growing kids learning center!
Thank you guys for doing your part and making thing easier in my life as a single parent!

title: They both love going everyday
name: Mark Shumann
quote: I am so happy and proud that my children are a part of Growing Kids Learning Center. They both love going everyday. Thank you to all of the staff and directors for everything you do.

title: She had such patience and a very compassionate caring attitude
name: Jessica Renee
quote:
Shalena Mitchell, I cannot say enough she went completely above and beyond to help get my son into “growing kids learning center” I was nervous about going in and doing the steps but she help me through everything!! She had such patience and a very compassionate, caring attitude and overall genuine attitude even helped me send my “CCDF paper” in her office to help me!!! I needed my son to start on (Monday the 11th) and she MADE that possible!!!!! I almost wanted to cry because SHE got him in!!!! Now my son can finally go to a safe, secure place every day!!!!
Shalena Mitchell, helped me through the process. Which is one of the reasons I CHOSE this daycare was by talking to her and her showing me a tour explaining everything with such patience! and this is why I chose this daycare. Thank you so much Shalena!! Very highly recommend speaking with her and recommending her in general!!!

title: The teachers are warm and inviting upon arrival
name: Gerald Bardeson
quote: This place is amazing. My son loves to go. The teachers are warm and inviting upon arrival. We have considered going elsewhere but in the end would have to sacrifice something that Growing Kids offers. They do it right. They are open for business most days of the year and offer summer and winter break camps for older siblings. Absolutely the best place we could find.

title: The kids and i love all of the activities and events
name: Marissa Tybor
quote:
I am happy to share our experience with you from Growing Kids Chesterton. We have attended for a year or more. My kids have attended daycare, after school care and summer camp here. We are definitely happy with the services and curriculum. Summer camp is very exciting for the kids because they do a lot of outdoor activities and field trips. My daughter’s daycare teacher teaches kids a little Spanish. May not seem like a lot, but some variability in their routine is positive and keeps my daughter interested. Overall, the staff are phenomenal. My kids will attend camp here and after school care until they age out. Also, the kids and I love all of the activities and events that Growing Kids Chesterton host. Overall, we have had a blast and look forward to both kids being in after school care.
Some other benefits :
1. No ipads or tech unless it involves homework.
2. Kids have homework time during school year.
3. Teachers communicate effectively when kids have “rough days.”
4. Growing Kids has soccer shots all year around (indoors when needed).
5. They have “Main Street” where kids get to play indoors on yucky days.
6. All parents and teachers/aides have communication folders.
7. Events (graduation, holiday celebrations).
8. All kids are included in events despite any challenges
9. Curriculum is positive!
10. Nap schedule is great too!

title: Great and friendly staff
name: Nereyda Rosas
quote: Great and friendly staff! Ms. Abigail, Mr. Christian and Ms. Karla are hands down the best. My niece’s love to attend and participate in many of there fun activities!

title: My babies feel welcomed safe and loved
name: Kayla Hurley
quote: I absolutely LOVE this facility! The staff is always so friendly, Ms. Karla is beyond helpful when it comes to registration, reassurance, and more. I’ve never felt more safer with a facility! They’re clean and made both of my babies feel welcomed, safe and loved when we moved up here from Tennessee and to this day. For me being a single mother I can say the process with them has never made me feel more secure, proud, welcomed, convenient and so much more ❤️ they always keep me up to date with everything throughout the day, my babies are ALWAYS fed, and I’ve never had to worry about if my babies are in any kind of danger they take the kids at the facility very seriously, treat them with respect, and best of all prioritize them. I will forever be grateful and thankful for everybody at growing kids in Plymouth! Keep up the great work. I highly recommend to everybody and anybody that’s looking for any kind of help when it comes to child care!
